en.t: Battle of the Lake of Antioch
en.s: The Battle of the Lake of Antioch took place on 9 February 1098 during the First Crusade. As the Crusaders were besieging Antioch, word reached the Crusader camp that a large relief force led by Radwan, the Seljuq ruler of Aleppo, was on the way. Bohemond of Taranto gathered all remaining horses and marched in the night to ambush the Muslim army.

zh.s: 1098年2月9日，第一次十字军东征期间，安条克湖战役爆发。十字军围攻安条克时，得知阿勒颇塞尔柱统治者里德万率领一支大军前来增援。塔兰托的博希蒙德召集所有剩余战马，趁夜行军，准备伏击穆斯林军队。

en.s: The Battle of Sanfengshan, literally the Battle of the Three-Peak Mountain, was a major decisive battle fought between the Mongol Empire and Jin China during the first stage of the Mongol conquest of the Jin dynasty. The battle was fought in 9 February 1232 at the Sanfeng Mountain which is in the southwest of what is now the city Yuzhou in Henan Province, China.

zh.s: 1232年2月9日，蒙古帝国与金朝在三峰山交战。这是蒙古灭金战争第一阶段的一场重大决战，战场位于今天中国河南省禹州市西南。

en.s: The siege of Caizhou in 1233 and 1234 was a battle fought between the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty and the allied forces of the Mongol Empire and Southern Song dynasty. It was the last major battle in the Mongol conquest of the Jin dynasty.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1233年至1234年，女真人建立的金朝与蒙古帝国和南宋联军围绕蔡州展开战斗。这是蒙古征服金朝期间最后一场重要战役。

en.s: Battle of Stubica (1573) was the decisive battle of Croatian-Slovene Peasant Revolt of 1573. The battle ended in the defeat of peasant rebel army.

zh.s: 斯图比察战役是1573年克罗地亚—斯洛文尼亚农民起义的决定性战役。战斗以农民起义军战败告终。

en.s: The Croatian–Slovene Peasant Revolt of 1573 was a large peasant revolt on territory forming modern-day northwestern Croatia and southeastern Slovenia. The revolt, sparked by cruel treatment of serfs by Baron Ferenc Tahy and led by Matija Gubec, ended after 12 days with the defeat of the rebels and bloody retribution by the nobility.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 克罗地亚—斯洛文尼亚农民起义
zh.s: 1573年克罗地亚—斯洛文尼亚农民起义发生在今克罗地亚西北部和斯洛文尼亚东南部，是一场规模较大的农民起义。农奴遭费伦茨·塔希男爵残酷对待后，马蒂亚·古贝茨领导起义。12天后，起义军战败，贵族随即展开血腥镇压。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Gregory XV becomes Pope, the last Pope elected by acclamation
en.s: Pope Gregory XV (Latin: Gregorius XV; Italian: Gregorio XV; 9 January 1554 – 8 July 1623), born Alessandro Ludovisi, was the head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 9 February 1621 until his death in 1623. He is notable for founding the Congregation for the Propagation of the Faith, an organization tasked with overseeing the spread of Catholicism and missionary work.

zh.t: 格列高利十五世当选教宗
zh.s: 教宗格列高利十五世（拉丁语：Gregorius XV；意大利语：Gregorio XV；1554年1月9日—1623年7月8日），本名亚历山德罗·卢多维西，自1621年2月9日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1623年去世。他创立了负责监督天主教传播和传教工作的万民福音部。

en.s: The Capture of Hormuz (Persian: بازپس گیری هرمز) was a combined Anglo-Persian expedition in 1622 that successfully captured the Portuguese fortress at Hormuz Island, thus opening up Persian trade with England in the Persian Gulf. Before the capture of Hormuz, the Portuguese had held the Castle of Hormuz for more than a century, since 1507 when Afonso de Albuquerque established it in the capture of Hormuz, giving them full control of the trade between India and Europe through the Persian Gulf.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 英波联合夺取霍尔木兹
zh.s: 霍尔木兹夺取行动（波斯语：بازپس گیری هرمز）是1622年英国与波斯联合发起的一次远征，成功攻占霍尔木兹岛上的葡萄牙要塞，打开了波斯与英国在波斯湾的贸易通道。此前，葡萄牙人自1507年阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克征服霍尔木兹并建立要塞以来，已控制霍尔木兹城堡一个多世纪。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Weymouth and the associated Crabchurch Conspiracy occurred in 1645, during the First English Civil War, when several royalist plotters within the twin towns of Weymouth and Melcombe on the Dorset coast conspired to deliver the ports back into the control of King Charles I.

zh.s: 韦茅斯战役及相关的克拉布彻奇阴谋发生于1645年第一次英国内战期间。多名保王派密谋者在多塞特郡海岸的韦茅斯和梅尔科姆双子城策划将港口交还给查理一世控制。

en.s: The Battle of Mazyr (Belarusian: Бітва пад Мазыром, Ukrainian: Битва під Мозирем, Polish: Bitwa pod Mozyrzem; 8–9 February 1649) was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth against the Zaporozhian Host as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the city of Mazyr in present-day Belarus, the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth’s forces under the command of Prince Janusz Radziwiłł, Adam Pawłowicz, Dzienaj Romanowski, Dawid Kiński and Dowgiałło captured the city of Mazyr, attacked and defeated a forces of the Zaporozhian Cossacks under the command of Colonel Mykhenko, who was killed in the battle.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莫济里战役（白俄罗斯语：Бітва пад Мазыром；乌克兰语：Битва під Мозирем；波兰语：Bitwa pod Mozyrzem；1649年2月8日至9日）是赫梅利尼茨基起义期间波兰立陶宛联邦与扎波罗热哥萨克军之间的一场战斗。波兰立陶宛军队由扬努什·拉齐维乌、亚当·帕夫沃维奇、杰奈·罗曼诺夫斯基、达维德·金斯基和多夫吉亚沃指挥，在今白俄罗斯莫济里附近攻占该城，击败米亨科上校指挥的扎波罗热哥萨克部队；米亨科在战斗中阵亡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Capture of Fort Rocher took place on 9 February 1654, during the Franco-Spanish War (1635–1659). Equipped with one siege battery, a Spanish expedition of 700 troops attacked the buccaneer stronghold of Tortuga, capturing the fort and 500 prisoners including 330 buccaneers and goods valued at approximately 160,000 pieces-of-eight. The Spanish burned the colony to the ground and slaughtered its inhabitants, leaving behind a fort manned by 150 soldiers. They possessed the island for about eighteen months, but on the approach of the expedition under Penn and Venerables were ordered by the Conde de Peñalva, Governor of Santo Domingo, to demolish the fortifications, bury the artillery and other arms, and retire to his aid in Hispaniola.

zh.s: 1654年2月9日，1635—1659年法西战争期间，700名西班牙远征军携一组攻城炮，袭击托尔图加岛的海盗据点罗谢堡，攻下堡垒，俘获500人，其中包括330名海盗，并夺取价值约16万枚八里亚尔银币的货物。西班牙人将殖民地夷为平地，屠杀居民，留下150名士兵驻守堡垒。他们控制该岛约18个月。后来，佩恩和维纳布尔斯率领的远征队逼近，圣多明各总督佩尼亚尔瓦伯爵命令驻军拆毁工事、掩埋火炮和其他武器，撤往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛支援他。

en.s: The siege of Hlukhiv (Ukrainian: Облога Глухова, Глухів, Russian: Осада Глухова, Глухов, Polish: Oblężenie Głuchowa, Głuchów; January 22 — 9 February 1664) was a battle of the Muscovite–Polish War (1654–1667). Near the site of the present-day city of Hlukhiv in Ukraine, the forces of the Polish King John II Casimir, numbering around 50,000–53,000 men, unsuccessfully besieged the Muscovite–Ukrainian Garrison of Hlukhiv and finally retreated under pressure from the Muscovite and Ukrainian Armies under the command of the Muscovite Prince Grigory Romodanovsky and the Ukrainian Hetman Ivan Briukhovetsky.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 赫卢希夫围城战（乌克兰语：Облога Глухова、Глухів；俄语：Осада Глухова、Глухов；波兰语：Oblężenie Głuchowa、Głuchów）是1654至1667年俄波战争中的一场战斗，发生于1664年1月22日至2月9日。波兰国王扬二世·卡齐米日率领约5万至5.3万人的军队，在今乌克兰赫卢希夫附近围攻莫斯科—乌克兰联军守军，但未能攻下该城，最终在格里戈里·罗莫达诺夫斯基王子和乌克兰盖特曼伊万·布留霍韦茨基指挥的莫斯科及乌克兰军队施压下撤退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: British Parliament presents address declaring Massachusetts in rebellion
en.s: On February 9, 1775, the two houses of the British Parliament presented an address to King George III stating that a rebellion existed in Massachusetts Bay. This was a parliamentary address in Britain, not the later declaration of all American colonies in rebellion.

zh.t: 英国议会向国王呈文，称马萨诸塞已发生叛乱
zh.s: 1775年2月9日，英国议会两院向乔治三世呈递奏文，称马萨诸塞湾省已经发生叛乱。此条记录英国议会的奏文，区别于后来将美洲殖民地整体宣布为叛乱的文告。

en.s: The siege of Šturlić was a minor engagement during the early stages of the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791. On February 9, 1788, the Habsburg emperor, Joseph II, delivered the declaration of war through his emissary in Constantinople. The very first engagements took place on the same day, Croatian battalions from Lika and Otočac moved on February 9 and headed towards the Bosnian borders and crossed the Korana River.

zh.s: 什图尔利奇围城战是1788至1791年奥土战争初期的一场小规模交战。1788年2月9日，哈布斯堡皇帝约瑟夫二世通过驻君士坦丁堡特使递交宣战书。首批战斗也在当天发生，来自利卡和奥托查茨的克罗地亚营向前推进，前往波斯尼亚边境并渡过科拉纳河。

en.t: 1789 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: Congressional elections to the 1st United States Congress were held in Georgia on February 9, 1789, for the state's three congressional districts. All elected representatives were members of the Anti-Administration political faction in Congress. The Georgia Election Act of 1789 established a mixed at-large/district system for congressional elections. Under the act, representatives were elected at-large on a general ticket but for three district-based seats, for which candidates were required to be residents.

zh.t: 1789年佐治亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1789年2月9日，佐治亚州举行选举，选出第一届美国国会的议员，代表该州3个国会选区。所有当选议员都属于国会中的反行政派。1789年《佐治亚州选举法》设立了普选和选区选举并行的制度。根据该法，候选人须居住在相应选区，但选举以全州普选形式举行，选出3个选区的代表。

en.s: The Sunda Strait campaign of January 1794 was a series of manoeuvres and naval actions fought between warships and privateers of the French Republic and a squadron of vessels sent by the British East India Company to protect trade in the region, later augmented by Dutch warships. The campaign developed as French forces based on Isle de France reacted more quickly than the British forces in the Indian Ocean to the expansion of the French Revolutionary Wars on 1 February 1793.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1794年1月巽他海峡战役是一系列海军机动和交战，参战方包括法兰西共和国海军舰艇和私掠船，以及英国东印度公司为保护当地贸易派出的舰队，之后又有荷兰军舰加入。1793年2月1日法国大革命战争扩大后，驻毛里求斯的法军行动速度快于印度洋上的英军，战役由此展开。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Action of 9 February 1799 was a minor naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars between a British Royal Navy frigate and a French privateer frigate fought 100 nautical miles (190 km) west of the southeastern coast of what is now Natal in South Africa. The 32-gun French frigate Prudente had since the start of the war been part of a squadron operating from Île de France (now Mauritius). This squadron had dispersed during 1798, with the ships sent on independent commerce raiding operations across the British trade routes in the Indian Ocean.

zh.s: 1799年2月9日，法国革命战争期间，一艘英国皇家海军护卫舰与一艘法国私掠护卫舰，在今天南非纳塔尔东南海岸以西约100海里（190公里）处发生小规模海战。配备32门炮的法国“谨慎”号护卫舰自战争开始起，就隶属于以法兰西岛、即今天毛里求斯为基地的一支舰队。该舰队于1798年分散，各舰独立袭扰印度洋上的英国贸易航线。

en.s: USS Constellation vs L'Insurgente, or the action of 9 February 1799, was a single-ship action fought between frigates of the French Navy and the United States Navy during the Quasi-War, an undeclared war that lasted from 1798 to 1800. The battle resulted in USS Constellation's capture of L'Insurgente, after an intense firefight in which both sides exchanged heavy broadsides and musket fire.

zh.s: 星座号对阵叛乱者号又称1799年2月9日海战，是准战争期间美国海军与法国海军护卫舰之间的一场单舰海战。战斗中，“星座”号俘获“叛乱者”号，双方曾激烈交火，互相发射舷侧炮弹和步枪弹。准战争是一场未正式宣战的战争，持续于1798年至1800年。

en.s: On 9 February 1801, representatives of France and Emperor Francis II signed the Treaty of Lunéville at Lunéville, France. Francis signed for his Habsburg hereditary lands and the Holy Roman Empire.
en.n: This records the treaty signing that marks the campaign endpoint in the source, not every fighting unit ending operations simultaneously.

zh.s: 1801年2月9日，法国与皇帝弗朗茨二世的代表在法国吕内维尔签署《吕内维尔和约》。弗朗茨二世代表哈布斯堡家族世袭领地及神圣罗马帝国签约。
zh.n: 此条记录原文用作战役阶段终点的和约签署，不表示所有部队都在同一刻停止行动。

en.s: On February 9, 1822, Haitian president Jean-Pierre Boyer entered Santo Domingo, in present-day Dominican Republic, beginning Haitian rule over the eastern part of Hispaniola. The short-lived independent state there had been known as Spanish Haiti.

zh.s: 1822年2月9日，海地总统让-皮埃尔·博耶进入今多米尼加共和国的圣多明各，海地由此开始统治伊斯帕尼奥拉岛东部。当地此前短暂独立的政权称为“西属海地”。

en.t: US House elects John Quincy Adams president
en.s: On February 9, 1825, the US House of Representatives elected John Quincy Adams president after no candidate had won an Electoral College majority. He won the votes of 13 of the 24 state delegations on the first ballot.

zh.t: 美国众议院选出约翰·昆西·亚当斯为总统
zh.s: 1825年2月9日，由于无人获得过半选举人票，美国众议院投票选举总统。约翰·昆西·亚当斯在首轮投票中获得24个州代表团中的13票，当选总统。

en.s: The naval Battle of Punta Colares, also known as the Battle of Corales, was the first major naval engagement of the Cisplatine War. It took place between a fleet of the Empire of Brazil, commanded by admiral Rodrigo José Ferreira Lobo, and a squadron of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata under the command of admiral William Brown. The confrontations began at around 10 o'clock on 9 February 1826 and lasted for seven hours.

zh.s: 蓬塔科拉雷斯海战又称科拉莱斯海战，是巴西战争首场大规模海上交战。巴西帝国舰队由罗德里戈·何塞·费雷拉·洛博海军将领指挥，拉普拉塔联合省舰队则由威廉·布朗指挥。战斗于1826年2月9日上午10时左右开始，持续七小时。

en.s: The naval Battle of Juncal took place between a squadron of the newly independent United Provinces of the River Plate under command of William Brown and a squadron belonging to the Brazilian Empire, commanded by Sena Pereira. It spanned two days, from 8 to 9 February 1827, in the waters of the Río de la Plata.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 洪卡尔海战是新独立的拉普拉塔联合省与巴西帝国之间的一场海战，双方分别由威廉·布朗和塞纳·佩雷拉指挥舰队。战斗在拉普拉塔河水域持续两天，从1827年2月8日至9日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The First Sumatran expedition, which featured the Battle of Quallah Battoo (Aceh: Kuala Batèë, Indonesian: Kuala Batu) in 1832, was a punitive expedition by the United States Navy against the village of Kuala Batee, presently a subdistrict in Southwest Aceh Regency. The reprisal was in response to the massacre of the crew of the merchantman Friendship a year earlier.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次苏门答腊远征包括1832年的瓜拉巴图战役（亚齐语：Kuala Batèë；印度尼西亚语：Kuala Batu），是美国海军针对瓜拉巴兑村（今属亚齐西南县）的惩罚性远征。行动是为了报复一年前商船“友谊号”船员遭屠杀一事。

en.s: The Battle of Piski was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849 fought on 9 February 1849 between the Hungarian army led by the Polish General Józef Bem and the Austrian army of the Habsburg Commander-in-Chief of Transylvania, Lieutenant General Anton Puchner.

zh.s: 1849年2月9日，1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争期间，波兰将军约瑟夫·贝姆率领的匈牙利军队，与哈布斯堡王朝特兰西瓦尼亚总司令安东·普赫纳中将指挥的奥军，在皮什基交战。

en.s: The Battle of Derasge was fought on 9 February 1855 between Kassa Hailu's forces and the forces of Wube Haile Maryam, Dejazmatch of Tigray. Kassa won the battle, and two days later was crowned Tewodros II of Ethiopia at the church of Derasge Mariam near Mekane Berhan.

zh.s: 德拉斯盖战役于1855年2月9日爆发，交战双方是卡萨·海卢的部队和提格雷领主武贝·海尔·马里亚姆的部队。卡萨获胜，两天后在梅卡内·贝尔汉附近的德拉斯盖·马里亚姆教堂加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝特沃德罗斯二世。

en.s: The battle of Melilla took place in February 1860, during the Spanish-Moroccan War, when the Spanish garrison of Melilla suffered a fiasco caused by Riffian fighters outside the city.

zh.s: 梅利利亚战役发生于1860年2月西班牙—摩洛哥战争期间。梅利利亚的西班牙驻军在城外遭到里夫战士袭击，惨败收场。

en.t: Grant signs resolution authorizing a national weather service
en.s: On February 9, 1870, US President Ulysses S. Grant signed a congressional joint resolution authorizing a national weather service under the War Department. This was a predecessor of today’s National Weather Service.

zh.t: 格兰特签署设立全国气象服务的决议

en.s: The Battle of San Roque was fought during the Philippine-American War between the United States and the First Philippine Republic. The battle resulted in the Filipinos being pushed off the causeway near San Roque, and forcing them to abandon their planned attack upon Cavite City itself.

en.s: The Battle of Port Arthur (Japanese: 旅順口海戦, Hepburn: Ryojunkō Kaisen) of 8–9 February 1904 marked the commencement of the Russo-Japanese War. It began with a surprise night attack by a squadron of Japanese destroyers on the neutral Russian fleet anchored at Port Arthur, Manchuria, and continued with an engagement the following morning; further skirmishing off Port Arthur would continue until May 1904. The attack ended inconclusively.

zh.s: 旅顺口海战（日本语：旅順口海戦，罗马字：Ryojunkō Kaisen）于1904年2月8日至9日爆发，标志着日俄战争开始。日本驱逐舰分舰队夜间突袭停泊在满洲旅顺口的俄罗斯中立舰队，次日早晨双方继续交战。旅顺口附近的小规模交火一直持续到1904年5月。此次袭击没有分出胜负。

en.s: The Svalbard Treaty (originally the Spitsbergen Treaty) recognises the sovereignty of Norway over the Arctic archipelago of Svalbard, at the time called Spitsbergen. The exercise of sovereignty is, however, subject to certain stipulations, and not all Norwegian law applies. The treaty restricts military uses of the archipelago, but it is not demilitarized. The signatories were given equal rights to engage in commercial activities (mainly coal mining) on the islands. Norway and Russia have exercised this right. Uniquely, the archipelago is an entirely visa-free zone under the terms of the Svalbard Treaty. The treaty was signed on 9 February 1920 and submitted for registration in the League of Nations Treaty Series on 21 October 1920.

zh.s: 《斯瓦尔巴条约》原称《斯匹次卑尔根条约》，承认挪威对北极斯瓦尔巴群岛的主权，当时该群岛称斯匹次卑尔根。不过，挪威行使主权须遵守条约中的一些规定，挪威法律也并非全部适用于当地。条约限制在群岛上的军事用途，但未规定群岛非军事化。签署国在群岛从事商业活动（主要是采煤）享有平等权利，挪威和俄罗斯都行使了这一权利。按条约规定，群岛是一个特殊的免签区。条约于1920年2月9日签署，并于同年10月21日提交国际联盟条约汇编登记。

en.s: The February 1927 Revolt, sometimes also referred to as the February 1927 Revolution, was a military rebellion in Portugal that took place between February 3 and 9, 1927, centered in Porto, the city where the insurgents' command center was installed and fought the main challenges. The revolt, led by Adalberto Gastão de Sousa Dias, ended with the surrender and arrest of the rebels and resulted in about 80 deaths and 360 injuries in Porto and more than 70 deaths and 400 injuries in Lisbon.

en.s: The assassination of Alfred François Bazin (French: [bazɛ̃]), a French labour recruiter in Hanoi, colonial Vietnam on February 9, 1929 marked the beginning of the demise of the Vietnamese Nationalist Party (VNQDĐ), which perpetrated the killing. The resulting French retribution severely weakened the fledgling Vietnamese revolutionary movement and hampered its ability to undermine colonial rule.

zh.t: 阿尔弗雷德·弗朗索瓦·巴赞遇刺
zh.s: 1929年2月9日，殖民地时期越南河内的一名法国劳工招募员阿尔弗雷德·弗朗索瓦·巴赞遇刺。越南国民党成员实施了这起刺杀，事件也标志着该党开始衰落。法国随后进行报复，严重削弱了新兴的越南革命运动，使其更难挑战殖民统治。

en.s: The 1929 Argentine Primera División final was the final match to define the 1929 Argentine Primera División championship. It was played between Gimnasia y Esgrima de La Plata and Boca Juniors after both teams won their respective groups at the end of the season. The match was held in the River Plate Stadium located in Recoleta, Buenos Aires.

zh.s: 1929年阿根廷甲级联赛决赛是决定当年联赛冠军的最后一场比赛，由在赛季结束后分别赢得各自分组的拉普拉塔体操击剑俱乐部和博卡青年队交手。比赛在布宜诺斯艾利斯雷科莱塔区的河床体育场举行。

en.t: Finland ratifies Alcohol Act replacing prohibition
en.s: On 9 February 1932, Finland ratified its Alcohol Act after Parliament voted to repeal prohibition. Alcohol sales under the new system began later, on April 5, 1932.

zh.t: 芬兰批准取代禁酒制度的《酒精法》
zh.s: 1932年2月9日，芬兰议会投票废除禁酒令后，新的《酒精法》获正式批准。新制度下的酒类销售于同年4月5日开始。

en.t: The Balkan Entente is formed between Greece, Romania, Yugoslavia, and Turkey
en.s: The Balkan Pact, or Balkan Entente, was a treaty signed by Greece, Romania, Turkey and Yugoslavia on 9 February 1934 in Athens, aimed at maintaining the geopolitical status quo in the region after the end of World War I. To present a united front against Bulgarian designs on their territories, the signatories agreed to suspend all disputed territorial claims against one another and their immediate neighbours following the aftermath of the war and a rise in various regional irredentist tensions.

zh.s: 1934年2月9日，希腊、罗马尼亚、土耳其和南斯拉夫在雅典签署《巴尔干公约》，又称《巴尔干协约》，旨在一战结束后维护地区地缘政治现状。为共同应对保加利亚对其领土的主张，签署国同意暂停彼此及邻国之间所有有争议的领土主张。当时地区的领土收复主义情绪有所上升。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 9 February 1936. León Cortés Castro of the Independent National Republican Party won the presidential election, whilst the party also won the parliamentary election, in which they received 59.4% of the vote. Voter turnout was 68.8% in the presidential election and 68.9% in the parliamentary election.

en.t: United States begins year-round War Time
en.s: On February 9, 1942, the United States began year-round daylight saving time, known as War Time, as a wartime measure. Clocks were advanced by one hour; the system continued until September 30, 1945.

en.s: The Guadalcanal campaign, also known as the Battle of Guadalcanal and codenamed Operation Watchtower by the United States, was an Allied offensive against forces of the Empire of Japan in the Solomon Islands during the Pacific Theater of World War II. It was fought between 7 August 1942 and 9 February 1943, and involved major land and naval battles on and surrounding the island of Guadalcanal.

en.s: The German U-boat U-864 was attacked and sunk on 9 February 1945 by HMS Venturer, a V-class submarine of the Royal Navy. Venturer was patrolling the waters around Fedje Island, off the Norwegian coast in the North Sea. The sinking remains the only incident in the history of naval warfare where one submarine sank another while both were submerged.

en.s: The Battle of Tsimba Ridge was an engagement of the Second World War involving Australian and Japanese forces. Part of the wider Bougainville campaign of the Pacific theatre, the battle occurred in the northern sector of Bougainville Island between 17 January and 9 February 1945, when the lead battalion of the Australian 11th Brigade—the 31st/51st Infantry Battalion—advanced towards the Genga River as part of a drive north to the Bonis Peninsula.

zh.s: 辛巴山脊战役是第二次世界大战期间澳大利亚军队与日军的一场交战，属于太平洋战场布干维尔战役的一部分。1945年1月17日至2月9日，双方在布干维尔岛北部交战。澳大利亚第11旅下属第31/51步兵营向北推进，前往博尼斯半岛方向的金加河。

en.s: On 9 February 1945, near the end of the Second World War, a force of Allied Bristol Beaufighter aircraft suffered many losses during an attack on the German destroyer Z33 and its escorting vessels; the operation was called Black Friday by the survivors. The German ships were sheltering in a strong defensive position in the Førde Fjord in Sogn og Fjordane county, Norway, forcing the Allied aircraft to attack through massed anti-aircraft fire (FlaK).

zh.s: 1945年2月9日，第二次世界大战接近尾声时，盟军一支布里斯托尔“英俊战士”飞机编队袭击德国驱逐舰Z33及其护航舰艇，损失惨重。幸存者称这次行动为“黑色星期五”。德国舰艇躲在挪威松恩-菲尤拉讷郡的福尔德峡湾一处防御严密的位置，盟军飞机只能穿过密集的防空炮火发动袭击。

en.s: The Colmar Pocket (French: Poche de Colmar; German: Brückenkopf Elsass) was the area held in central Alsace, France, by the German Nineteenth Army from November 1944 to February 1945, against the U.S. 6th Army Group (6th AG) during World War II. en.t: The Geochang massacre begins in South Korea
en.s: South Korean army troops began a three-day massacre of civilians in the Geochang area on February 9 during the Korean War. The dedicated article reports 719 unarmed victims, including children, and describes later attempts to conceal the killings. Parliamentary investigations followed after a lawmaker raised the case, although the military initially obstructed inquiries. The killings are remembered as one of the grave abuses against civilians during the conflict. Because the massacre continued through February 11, this entry marks its beginning; it does not assign every death to February 9.

en.t: The exchange officially commenced operations on 9 February 1962
en.s: The Taiwan Stock Exchange Corporation (TWSE; Chinese: 臺灣證券交易所) is a financial institution, headquartered at Taipei 101, in Taipei, Taiwan. The TWSE was established in 1961 and began operating as a stock exchange on 9 February 1962. It is regulated by the Financial Supervisory Commission. TWSE-listed securities currently include stocks, as well as exchange-traded funds (ETFs), exchange-traded notes (ETNs), warrants, Taiwan Depositary Receipts (TDRs), and other securities.

zh.t: 台湾证券交易所正式开始营业
zh.s: 台湾证券交易所（TWSE；中文：臺灣證券交易所）是一家总部位于台湾台北市台北101大楼的金融机构。交易所于1961年成立，并于1962年2月9日正式开始营业，由金融监督管理委员会监管。目前在交易所上市的证券包括股票、交易所交易基金（ETF）、交易所交易票据（ETN）、认股权证、台湾存托凭证（TDR）及其他证券。

en.s: An election was held in 1969 to elect members to the Bihar Legislative Assembly, the lower house of the legislature of the Indian state of Bihar. After the elections, the Congress emerged as the largest party, and Harihar Singh was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar. en.s: An independence referendum was held in Lithuania on 9 February 1991, eleven months after independence from the Soviet Union had been declared on 11 March 1990. en.s: On 9 February 2016, two Meridian-branded passenger trains collided head-on at Bad Aibling, Germany. Of approximately 150 people on board the two trains, 12 people died and 85 others were injured, 24 critically. Two months after the crash, investigators announced that it had been caused by a Deutsche Bahn train dispatcher who gave incorrect instructions to the two trains while distracted by a game he was playing on his mobile phone. The dispatcher further compounded his error when, upon realizing it, he tried to send emergency codes to the trains but entered the wrong combination into his computer.

zh.s: 2016年2月9日，两列Meridian客运列车在德国巴特艾布灵迎头相撞。两车约150人中，12人死亡、85人受伤，其中24人伤势危重。事故两个月后，调查人员宣布，德国铁路一名列车调度员因玩手机游戏分心，向两列火车发出错误指令，导致事故。他意识到错误后试图向列车发送紧急代码，却在电脑中输入了错误组合，使情况进一步恶化。

en.s: The opening ceremony of the 2018 Winter Olympics was held at the Pyeongchang Olympic Stadium in Pyeongchang, South Korea on 9 February 2018.
